# Analyze the problem:
# - 12 vertices total
# - Exactly 1 clique of size 5
# - Every vertex must belong to one of these cliques
# - Only edges are within these cliques

# If we have exactly 1 clique of size 5, that accounts for 5 vertices.
# But we have 12 vertices total, and every vertex must belong to one of these cliques.
# With only 1 clique of size 5, only 5 vertices are covered.
# The remaining 12 - 5 = 7 vertices cannot belong to any clique.

# This is a contradiction: every vertex must belong to one of the cliques,
# but 7 vertices would be left uncovered.

num_vertices = 12
num_cliques = 1
clique_size = 5

vertices_covered = num_cliques * clique_size
print(f"Vertices covered by {num_cliques} clique(s) of size {clique_size}: {vertices_covered}")
print(f"Total vertices: {num_vertices}")
print(f"Uncovered vertices: {num_vertices - vertices_covered}")

if vertices_covered == num_vertices:
    print("SAT: All vertices covered")
else:
    print("UNSAT: Not all vertices can be covered")
